## Overview

This document creates the shared analytical datasets used by all downstream analyses.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)

source(here("R", "io.R"))

followup_limit_days <- 182L

ensure_dir(here("output", "derived"))
```

```{r}
#| label: lookup

long_version_order <- c(
  "distress_therm", "q29", "q30", paste0("q", 1:28)
)

short_version_order <- c(
  "q29", "q30", "q3", "q4", "q5", "q18", "q8", "q9",
  paste0("q", 11:17), "q19", "q24", "q21"
)

questionnaire_model_items <- long_version_order
questionnaire_response_fields <- c(
  "distress_therm_2", "distress_therm_v2", "distress_therm_inpat",
  "q29", "q30", paste0("q", 1:28)
)

position_lookup <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    form_type = "long_version",
    item_code = long_version_order,
    item_position_within_form = seq_along(long_version_order)
  ),
  tibble(
    form_type = "short_version",
    item_code = short_version_order,
    item_position_within_form = seq_along(short_version_order)
  ))
# ) |>

#       item_code = long_version_order,
#       item_position_global = seq_along(long_version_order)
#     ),
#     by = "item_code"
#   )
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
raw_data <- read_parquet(here("data", "clean", "analysis_data_long_2026-08-11.parquet"))

harmonized_data <- raw_data |>
  mutate(
    distress_therm = coalesce(
      distress_therm_2,
      distress_therm_v2,
      distress_therm_inpat
    ),
    any_questionnaire_response = select(
      pick(everything()),
      all_of(questionnaire_response_fields)
    ) |>
      (\(x) rowSums(!is.na(x)) > 0)(),
    valid_encounter_type = !is.na(encounter_type) & encounter_type %in% c(1, 2, 3)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: derive-patients-baseline
patient_rows <- raw_data |>
  arrange(pat_id, days_since_fstcnt, app_day) |>
  group_by(pat_id) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()

top5_diag <- patient_rows |>
  count(diagnosis, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(!is.na(diagnosis)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  pull(diagnosis)

top5_plan <- patient_rows |>
  count(plan_fstcnt_coded, sort = TRUE) |>
  filter(!is.na(plan_fstcnt_coded)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  pull(plan_fstcnt_coded)

questionnaire_counts <- harmonized_data |>
  filter(
    quest_status == 1,
    valid_encounter_type,
    is.na(noquestionnaire) | noquestionnaire != 4,
    !is.na(days_since_fstcnt),
    days_since_fstcnt >= 0,
    days_since_fstcnt <= followup_limit_days
  ) |>
  count(pat_id, name = "n_questionnaires")

appointment_counts <- raw_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(days_since_fstcnt),
    days_since_fstcnt >= 0,
    days_since_fstcnt <= followup_limit_days
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_appointments = n_distinct(days_since_fstcnt),
    .by = "pat_id"
  )

patients_baseline <- patient_rows |>
  mutate(
    age = pat_age,
    sex = factor(gender),
    marital_status_fct = case_when(
      marital_status %in% c("gesch.", "getr.", "verw.") ~ "separated",
      marital_status %in% c("ledig") ~ "single",
      marital_status %in% c("verh.") ~ "married",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    marital_status_fct = factor(marital_status_fct, levels = c("single", "married", "separated", "other"),
      labels = c("Single", "Married", "Separated", "Other")),
    language_fct = case_when(
      language %in% c("Deutsch") ~ "german",
      language %in% c("Englisch") ~ "english",
      language %in% c("Italienisch") ~ "italian",
      language %in% c("Französisch") ~ "french",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    language_fct = factor(language_fct, levels = c("german", "english", "italian", "french", "other"),
      labels = c("German", "English", "Italian", "French", "Other")),
    ecog_baseline = ordered(ecog_fstcnt),
    ecog_baseline_analysis = ordered(
      if_else(
        as.character(ecog_fstcnt) %in% c("3", "4"),
        "3+",
        as.character(ecog_fstcnt)
      ),
      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+")
    ),
    diagnosis = factor(diagnosis),
    diagnosis_group = factor(
      case_when(
        is.na(diagnosis) ~ "Missing",
        diagnosis %in% top5_diag ~ as.character(diagnosis),
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      levels = c(top5_diag, "Other", "Missing")
    ),
    treatment_plan = factor(plan_fstcnt_coded),
    treatment_plan_group = factor(
      case_when(
        is.na(plan_fstcnt_coded) ~ "Missing",
        plan_fstcnt_coded %in% top5_plan ~ as.character(plan_fstcnt_coded),
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      levels = c(top5_plan, "Other", "Missing")
    ),
    reminder = factor(reminder, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  ) |>
  select(
    pat_id,
    age,
    sex,
    language = language_fct,
    marital_status = marital_status_fct,
    ecog_baseline,
    ecog_baseline_analysis,
    diagnosis,
    diagnosis_group,
    treatment_plan,
    treatment_plan_group,
    reminder
  ) |>
  left_join(questionnaire_counts, by = "pat_id") |>
  left_join(appointment_counts, by = "pat_id") |>
  mutate(
    n_questionnaires = replace_na(n_questionnaires, 0L),
    n_appointments = replace_na(n_appointments, 0L)
  )

martial_status <- patients_baseline |>
  count(marital_status, sort = TRUE)

language <- patients_baseline |>
  count(language, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: derive-questionnaires-wide

invalid_questionnaires <- harmonized_data |>
  filter(quest_status == 1, !valid_encounter_type)

technical_failure_questionnaires <- invalid_questionnaires |>
  filter(!any_questionnaire_response)

response_present_invalid_questionnaires <- invalid_questionnaires |>
  filter(any_questionnaire_response)

if (nrow(response_present_invalid_questionnaires) > 0) {
  invalid_keys <- response_present_invalid_questionnaires |>
    mutate(
      invalid_key = paste(
        pat_id,
        days_since_fstcnt,
        app_day,
        encounter_type,
        sep = "/"
      )
    ) |>
    pull(invalid_key)

  stop(
    paste(
      "Found quest_status == 1 rows with invalid encounter_type and observed responses:",
      paste(invalid_keys, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

questionnaires_wide <- harmonized_data |>
  filter(quest_status == 1, valid_encounter_type) |>
  arrange(pat_id, days_since_fstcnt, app_day) |>
  group_by(pat_id) |>
  mutate(questionnaire_number = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    questionnaire_key = paste(pat_id, questionnaire_number, sep = "_"),
    form_type = case_when(
      encounter_type == 1 ~ "long_version",
      encounter_type %in% c(2, 3) ~ "short_version"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    form_type = factor(form_type, levels = c("long_version", "short_version")),
    noquestionnaire = factor(noquestionnaire, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c(
        "Completed independently",
        "Patient declined to complete",
        "Patient unable to complete",
        "Technical issues",
        "Completed with assistance"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    pat_id,
    questionnaire_number,
    questionnaire_key,
    form_type,
    noquestionnaire,
    days_since_first_contact = days_since_fstcnt,
    days_since_questionnaire_program_start = days_since_intro_quest,
    days_since_liqplat_start = days_since_start_liqplat,
    days_since_liqplat_screening = days_since_screening,
    app_day,
    encounter_type,
    distress_therm,
    q29,
    q30,
    all_of(paste0("q", 1:28))
  ) |>
  left_join(patients_baseline, by = "pat_id") |> 
  # remove technical failures
  filter_out(noquestionnaire == "Technical issues")
```

```{r}
#| label: derive-questionnaire-items
questionnaire_items_long <- questionnaires_wide |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(questionnaire_model_items),
    names_to = "item_code",
    values_to = "response"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    is_structural_absence = form_type == "short_version" & !(item_code %in% short_version_order),
    is_answered = !is.na(response) & !is_structural_absence
  ) |>
  left_join(position_lookup, by = c("form_type", "item_code")) |>
  mutate(
    is_missing_nonstructural = !is_structural_absence & is.na(response)
  ) |>
  arrange(pat_id, questionnaire_number, item_position_within_form)
```

```{r}
#| label: derive-questionnaire-summaries
questionnaire_summary_base <- questionnaire_items_long |>
  filter(!is_structural_absence) |>
  summarise(
    n_items_eligible = n(),
    n_items_answered = sum(is_answered),
    n_items_missing_nonstructural = sum(is_missing_nonstructural),
    prop_missing_nonstructural = mean(is_missing_nonstructural),
    last_answered_position = {
      answered_positions <- item_position_within_form[is_answered]
      if (length(answered_positions) == 0) {
        0L
      } else {
        max(answered_positions)
      }
    },
    any_missing_nonstructural = any(is_missing_nonstructural),
    .by = c(
      "pat_id", "questionnaire_number", "questionnaire_key", "form_type", "noquestionnaire",
      "days_since_first_contact", "days_since_questionnaire_program_start",
      "days_since_liqplat_start", "days_since_liqplat_screening",
      "app_day", "encounter_type", "age", "sex", "language", "marital_status", "ecog_baseline",
      "ecog_baseline_analysis",
      "diagnosis", "diagnosis_group", "treatment_plan",
      "treatment_plan_group", "reminder"
    )
  )

terminal_missing <- questionnaire_items_long |>
  filter(!is_structural_absence) |>
  left_join(
    questionnaire_summary_base |>
      select(questionnaire_key, last_answered_position),
    by = "questionnaire_key"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_terminal_missing = sum(
      is_missing_nonstructural &
        item_position_within_form > last_answered_position
    ),
    n_intermittent_missing = sum(
      is_missing_nonstructural &
        item_position_within_form <= last_answered_position
    ),
    .by = "questionnaire_key"
  )

#1	Ja
# 5	Ja - mit Unterstützung
# 2	Patientin / Patient möchte Fragebogen nicht ausfüllen
# 3	Patientin / Patient kann Fragebogen nicht ausfüllen
# 4	Technische Probleme

questionnaires <- questionnaire_summary_base |>
  left_join(terminal_missing, by = "questionnaire_key") |>
  mutate(
    n_terminal_missing = replace_na(n_terminal_missing, 0L),
    n_intermittent_missing = replace_na(n_intermittent_missing, 0L)  
)
```

```{r}
#| label: save-derived
write_parquet(patients_baseline, here("output", "derived", "patients_baseline.parquet"))
write_parquet(questionnaires, here("output", "derived", "questionnaires.parquet"))
write_parquet(questionnaire_items_long, here("output", "derived", "questionnaire_items_long.parquet"))
```
